faq.description: Clear answers about plans, credits, and your image-editing workspace.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

refundPolicy.question: How are refunds handled?
refundPolicy.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the applicable payment terms. Contact support with your billing details for review.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel your subscription by visiting the billing page.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time by visiting the billing page.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free plan?
freeTrial.answer: Yes. The Free plan includes 25 monthly credits and access to Standard Edit.

features.title: From source image to controlled edit
features.description: EzPic keeps the edit prompt, quality choice, credits, and private assets in one focused workspace.

feature1.title: Directed edits
feature1.subtitle: Describe the change instead of rebuilding the image.
feature1.description: Every public edit starts with a required source image and a clear instruction.

benefit1.title: Prompted changes
benefit1.description: State what should change in plain language.

benefit2.title: Source required
benefit2.description: The editor never presents text-only image generation as an EzPic product.

benefit3.title: Two edit levels
benefit3.description: Choose Standard Edit or Quality Edit when your plan allows it.

feature2.title: Private workflow
feature2.subtitle: Keep source images, edits, and status in your workspace.
feature2.description: Credits are reserved before work starts and settled against the completed job state.

benefit1.title: Private assets
benefit1.description: Inputs and outputs remain account-scoped media assets.

benefit2.title: Visible credit cost
benefit2.description: Review the credit reservation before confirming an edit.

benefit3.title: Recoverable history
benefit3.description: Return to edit history and inspect the latest job state.
